mapper.insert: insert into tbl_trip_companion (trip_id, member_id, companion_is_member, companion_name, companion_contact, companion_relation) values (#{tripId}, #{memberId}, #{companionIsMember}, #{companionName}, #{companionContact}, #{companionRelation})
mapper.select: select id, trip_id, member_id, companion_is_member, companion_name, companion_contact, companion_relation, created_datetime from tbl_trip_companion where trip_id = #{tripId} order by id
